appOverview: Configuración is reached from Dashboard's settings-menu (which stops being a disabled placeholder) and is three separate top-level views: app-teacher-settings-view (/configuracion/profesor — edit the signed-in teacher's full name; change password), app-training-catalog-settings-view (/configuracion/ciclos-modulos — master CRUD over a shared, global catalog of ciclos formativos and módulos profesionales, seeded from the official BOC curricula, un-scoped from any teacher as of 2026-08-05), and app-academic-year-settings-view (/configuracion/ano-academico — each signed-in teacher's own list of academic years, each with the cycles/módulos they teach that year, picked from the shared catalog). Each has its own Shadow DOM and is reached by a plain nav link (teacher-nav-link / training-catalog-nav-link / academic-year-nav-link) rendered identically on all three screens via one shared function. **Redesign history**: 2026-08-04 dropped the old, teacher-owned training_cycles/modules/academic_years/academic_year_modules tables and rebuilt Ciclos/Módulos as a standalone catalog with a UI-only Año académico stub. 2026-08-05 gives Año académico a real data layer again — academic_years (per-teacher: id, teacher_id, start_year integer displayed as "2026-2027", is_current) and academic_year_modules (join to catalog_modules; a row's cycle is derived via catalog_modules.catalog_training_cycle_id, not stored again) — built on top of the shared catalog instead of duplicating it per teacher. Creating brand-new cycles/módulos is no longer possible from this screen: every cycle/módulo a teacher assigns to a year must already exist in the Ciclos/Módulos catalog, so training-cycle-table-add-button, module-table-add-button, module-edit-confirm-modal, training-cycle-delete-blocked-message and module-delete-blocked-message are removed. A new, reusable Toast component (academic-year-toast, first used here) surfaces this screen's two error cases: a duplicate start year on rename, and a blocked delete when the year still has módulos assigned.

globalRules: This is three separate top-level custom elements (app-teacher-settings-view, app-training-catalog-settings-view, app-academic-year-settings-view), each its own Shadow DOM, each its own route. Shared nav markup (teacher-nav-link/training-catalog-nav-link/academic-year-nav-link) comes from one plain function called by all three
All three screens require a valid session — no session redirects to /login, same gate as Dashboard

Ciclos/Módulos (app-training-catalog-settings-view) owns two shared, global tables, catalog_cycles and catalog_modules, with no FK to users — no dependency-blocked deletion, no edit-confirmation modal, unlike the old training_cycles/modules pair. Uniqueness is global (not per teacher): ciclo nombre; módulo nombre within its (ciclo, curso)

Año académico (app-academic-year-settings-view) has a real backend as of 2026-08-05: academic_years and academic_year_modules (see their elementSpecs). academic_years rows are scoped per teacher (teacher_id FK, start_year unique within teacher_id); academic_year_modules rows reference catalog_modules — a cycle/módulo can only be assigned to a year if it already exists in the shared Ciclos/Módulos catalog, this screen creates none of its own
Deleting an academic_years row is blocked at the application level (not a DB constraint) while it still has academic_year_modules rows — 409 HAS_DEPENDENTS, surfaced via academic-year-toast
A duplicate academic_years.start_year for the same teacher is rejected — 409 DUPLICATE_NAME, surfaced via academic-year-toast
academic-year-toast is a new, reusable Web Component (not scoped to this view) — any future view needing a transient, auto-dismissing notification can reuse it instead of building another one
